meta.note: ACE profile: the Forza Motorsport v6 calibration, refitted where HaptiConnect's own Assetto Corsa Evo plugin measurably differs. Engine, gear shift and impact keep the single-plugin Forza values; the road bed, acceleration, wheel slip, wheel lock and ABS are refitted to ONE copy of the Evo plugin (see parity_ace_final_2026-09-20).
meta.ace_fit: Measured on replay --plugin ace references (sessions/ace_drive_3_hc_ace, ace_drive_2_hc_ace; tools in the maintainer's calibration notes (not published)): HaptiConnect's ACE plugin plays no shift light (its 70 Hz line stays at 0.008-0.020 above 0.855 x max rpm, ours was 0.40) and no kerb cycle (its extra energy on kerbs is the suspension bed), so shift_indicator and road are silenced by gain 0 rather than switched off. It fires the gear-shift burst only when a gear engages (45 of 47 changes into a gear, 0 of 35 into neutral), so fire_into_neutral is false and neutral_window_s 0. The references carry two plugin copies (doubled square edges 0.2-2.2 ms apart, an engine line that swings between 0 and 2x one copy). ENGINE and GEAR SHIFT keep the single-plugin Forza values (0.159 engine, 0.32 shift) and are matched. The BED no longer does: it was refitted per copy in 2026-09-20 (see parity_ace_suspension), which supersedes the old 'bed levels keep the Forza values' sentence.
meta.parity_ace_final_2026-09-20: Final ACE parity candidate, built from the shipped profiles/ace/profile.json. Target: ONE copy of HaptiConnect's own Assetto Corsa Evo plugin - the ACE-plugin references hold two plugin renderings, which ab_report and optimize score 3.01 dB down. Scripts and outputs in the maintainer's calibration notes (not published). Fitted on ace_drive_3_hc_ace, held out ace_drive_2_hc_ace. Every effect is measured SYMMETRICALLY: HaptiConnect's recording per copy against OUR FULL MIX, same 341 ms windows, same band, real renders on both sides. All numbers here were re-measured on today's scorer (openshaker/optimize render cache v5, per-effect renders scaled back below the 0.9 knee) and are identical on seeds 1 and 2. Scores: ace_drive_3_hc_ace level +2.0 -> +0.4 dB, Dist 4.63 -> 2.30, corr 0.49 -> 0.62; ace_drive_2_hc_ace (held out) level +1.7 -> -0.2 dB, Dist 4.46 -> 2.11, corr 0.49 -> 0.61. The Forza-plugin replays of the same two drives are a DIFFERENT plugin and are informational only - they get worse: ace_drive_3_hc Dist 6.43 -> 8.45 (level -3.4 -> -4.9 dB), ace_drive_2_hc2 5.86 -> 7.82 (-2.8 -> -4.4 dB). Changed against the previous candidate (candidates/ace/profile_parity_ace.json): the bed refit, and wheel_lock.gain 0.06 -> 0.085. Untouched: engine, gear_shift, impact, road (gain 0), shift_indicator (gain 0).
meta.parity_ace_suspension: 41 Hz bed refitted to an INDEPENDENT narrow-band measure: the raw 38-44.5 Hz sine amplitude of HaptiConnect per copy against our full mix, on windows where the engine line and its 2nd harmonic cannot reach 33-49 Hz (521 usable windows on training, 117 on the holdout), with no shelf subtraction on either side. Fitted on ace_drive_3_hc_ace only. Per suspension-velocity bin (vpeak <0.5 / 0.5-1 / 1-2 / 2-4.5 / 4.5-8.5 / >=8.5 per s) the mean moves from base +15.8/+9.4/+2.9/+3.9/+5.5/+3.5 dB to -3.0/+3.3/-1.3/-1.6/-0.3/-2.0 dB, overall +4.4 -> -1.2 dB. The previous candidate was +9.3/+6.0/+5.0/+2.4/+1.8/+1.0, overall +2.7 dB, and its 1-2 per s bin was LOUDER than the base. The level lives in vel_curve, so gain is 1.0. The curve is flat above 8.5 per s because flattening there changes no bin of either reference by 0.1 dB - no data constrains it. HaptiConnect plays no 41 Hz line below about 0.5 per s (its mean 41.0 Hz bin there, 0.0017, sits below the local shelf of 0.0034), so speed_floor_curve is zero. See the maintainer's calibration notes (not published).
meta.parity_ace_suspension_holdout: The holdout is not a fair test of the bed as the scorer reads it today. sessions/ace_drive_2 was logged with ace_susp_scale_m 0.05 and sessions/ace_drive_3 with 0.08, and the maintainer's calibration notes (not published) stores susp_travel normalised by that scale, so our suspension velocities on ace_drive_2_hc_ace come out 1.6x too large; ab_report rescales only the column replays (LEGACY_ACE_SUSP_SCALE covers ace_drive_2_hc and ace_drive_2_hc2) and prints 'scored without a suspension rescale' for this pair. As scored, the narrow-band bed on the holdout is base +10.6 -> candidate +5.2 dB. With susp_travel x 0.625 applied it reads base +4.2 -> candidate -1.4 dB mean (median +3.0 -> -0.6), and the previous candidate +2.4 / +3.5. The 5.7 dB is ours, not HaptiConnect's. See the same notes.
meta.parity_ace_acceleration: gain 0.12 -> 0.025, curve_long reshaped (zero below 2 m/s2, saturating by 5) and curve_lat flat zero - unchanged from the previous round, which a skeptic confirmed. Re-measured here with the engine line and its 2nd and 3rd harmonics notched out of the band AND the guard bands: forward 3.5-6 m/s2 base +8.9 -> -0.9 dB (training, n 62) and +9.2 -> -0.6 dB (holdout, n 13); forward >= 6 m/s2 +10.0 -> -0.7 dB (training, n 18); forward 2-3.5 m/s2 +7.3 -> -3.1 dB (n 42). NOT claimed: that HaptiConnect plays nothing under braking or on lateral g. With the engine notched its 52-66 Hz excess is +0.0223 at lateral 4-6 m/s2 (n 17) and +0.0153 at lateral >= 6 (n 31) against +0.0123 in a matched null (n 101), so it does put something there while cornering and our flat-zero curve_lat plays nothing; the -8.0 dB left on the lateral >= 6 row is a known deficit, not a match. The size of that lateral term is not settled: measured with a narrower band and different guards it changes sign between the two references, so only its existence is claimed here. Braking: on 61 shift-free braking windows with no locking wheel (brake > 0.2) HaptiConnect still carries about 0.0094 of engine-notched 52-66 Hz excess, where our reshaped curve_long plays nothing below 2 m/s2 of forward g - about 7 dB short. Left as measured rather than fitted: braking and lock overlap on these drives.
meta.parity_ace_wheel_slip: gain 0.1313 -> 0.070 with the Forza triggers replaced: slip_angle 1.1/1.5, slip_ratio 1.4/2.0, and the old 1.2 / 1.4 caps removed (slide_max and spin_max 1000). Unchanged from the previous round and confirmed. Re-measured here (engine-notched 50-62 Hz excess, full mix): at slip hint >= 0.65 base +10.4 -> +0.1 dB (training, n 84) and +5.7 -> -1.5 dB (holdout, n 55); where the hint stays under 0.2 while the old triggers fired, +22.0 -> -5.7 dB (n 115); spin >= 1.4 +6.0 -> -0.1 dB (training, n 40) and +4.4 -> -1.3 dB (holdout, n 43). Open: the two references disagree above |slip_angle| 1.2. On training those 34 windows show HaptiConnect at only +0.0045 while we play +0.0229 (+14.1 dB; base +29.0); on the holdout's 40 such windows HaptiConnect is +0.0806 and we are -1.4 dB. The trigger shape above 1.2 is not settled.
meta.parity_ace_wheel_lock: gain 0.18 -> 0.085, chosen from the measurement rather than from the previous round's 3-event onset contrast (which gave 0.06 and left us 3.2 dB under HaptiConnect on the holdout). On the training reference's 8 lock windows (-slip_ratio >= 3.5 with brake > 0.05) HaptiConnect's MEAN engine-notched 50-62 Hz excess is +0.0255 per copy (the median of the same 8 windows is far lower, so this row alone spans about 8 dB); our full mix gives +0.0169 at gain 0.06 (-3.6 dB), +0.0259 at 0.085 (+0.1 dB) and +0.0313 at 0.10 (+1.8 dB). On the holdout's 29 lock windows HaptiConnect is +0.0943 and we move from -2.8 dB at 0.06 to -1.4 dB at 0.085 (0.11 would match that reference; 0.085 is the training answer and is what is kept). In the full-mix table the row goes base +14.8 -> +0.3 dB (training) and +3.9 -> -1.3 dB (holdout). n is small - 8 and 29 windows over 3 and 2 lock events - so the gain is uncertain by about a factor 1.3 either way. See the maintainer's calibration notes (not published).
meta.parity_ace_abs: abs.gain 0.25 -> 0. This is an ENGINEERING CHOICE, not a measured absence. HaptiConnect does put more into the 13 Hz component of its 45-70 Hz envelope while the ABS hint is up than while braking without it: 0.0145 against 0.0099 (n 107 and 26 windows on ace_drive_3_hc_ace, +46%) and 0.0214 against 0.0164 (n 25 and 16 on ace_drive_2_hc_ace, +30%), over a matched null of 0.0094 and 0.0093. That difference, about 0.005 of envelope amplitude, co-occurs with wheel lock and is far smaller than what our ABS effect added - it raised our own envelope from 0.0184 to 0.0340 at the same training moments - so the effect is silenced with gain 0 rather than fitted to it. A real ABS fit needs data where ABS engages without a locking wheel. See the maintainer's calibration notes (not published).
meta.parity_ace_engine_and_shift: Untouched, and they do not move: the engine line is +2.29 dB (base) -> +2.27 dB (this candidate) against HaptiConnect per copy on training (n 215) and -0.14 -> -0.13 dB on the holdout (n 64); the gear-shift burst peak is -0.58 -> -0.72 dB and -1.07 -> -1.15 dB. The '-8.5 dB below 4000 rpm' reading on ace_drive_3_hc_ace is an artefact of the two plugin copies, not ducking: two copies a few ms apart sum to 2|cos(pi f dt)| x one copy, so at 1500-2500 rpm the raw sum swings from a median of 0.0505 to a p95 of 0.2979 at the SAME rpm. That sum's upper envelope is 2x one copy, and it gives per copy 0.1553 below 4000 rpm against our 0.1431 (+0.7 dB), 0.1264 above 4000 against our 0.1372 (-0.7 dB), and 0.1367 against 0.1509 (-0.9 dB) on the holdout - flat, and matched within 1 dB. At 943 rpm on the training reference the sum is 0.3104 while the Forza-plugin replay of the same drive reads 0.1553, exactly 2.00x: fully coherent, no duck. Nothing in this candidate compensates for it - engine.gain is unchanged and every fit here either notches the engine line out of band and guards or uses windows it cannot reach. See the maintainer's calibration notes (not published).
meta.applied: 2026-09-20 from the maintainer's calibration notes (not published)

probes.acceleration: ~60 Hz tone; on at ~3 m/s2 accelerating, ~7 braking, ~7 lateral; full scale within ~1-2 m/s2 (lower thresholds than the BeamNG plugin)
probes.collision: fixed ~45 ms hit 20-38 Hz on g jumps >= ~15 m/s2 held >= 3 frames, long or lat; speed drops alone ignored
probes.engine: tone at rpm/60 Hz, ~0.9 amplitude, no harmonics, throttle independent
probes.wheel_slip: band-limited: rear slip ratio ~0.5-1.3 or slip angle ~0.5-0.8 -> 54.5 Hz tone; larger values, front/all-wheel spin ignored
probes.rumble_strips: no response in either layout: non-functional
probes.shift_indicator: no response in either layout: non-functional
probes.wheel_lock: 56.4 Hz full-scale tone only when the FRONT wheels lock while the rears keep turning, under brake
probes.layout: this plugin decodes gear/pedals at the Forza HORIZON offsets; the 324-byte layout must be used
probes.gear_shift: 94 ms full-scale burst on every gear-byte change (Horizon layout); pure rpm drops ignored
probes.suspension: 41.2 Hz square wave, continuous; amplitude follows recent suspension velocity (1 s peak-hold): ~0.03 smooth, 0.08 at 15/s, 0.2 at 25+/s (strength 0.5)
probes.waveforms: engine, lock, acceleration: sine; suspension: square (h3 .33 h5 .2); gear shift: square-ish burst; slip: sine + small h3
probes.engine_lap: engine amplitude constant 0.159 on the lap regardless of throttle/speed/rpm/gear (strength 0.5)

analysis.strength_law: HaptiConnect effect strength 0.5 produced ~0.22 of the strength-1.0 amplitude (about -13 dB) on the real lap
analysis.rumble_strips: measured on real laps: HaptiConnect DOES render rumble strips (SurfaceRumble 1.5-2.6 + wheel flag): looped rough cycle at ~1.25 Hz per m/s capped ~42 Hz, rms ~0.3 falling to ~0.15 at high speed (strength 0.5); the earlier probe used SurfaceRumble <= 1.0 and never triggered it
analysis.suspension: 41.0 Hz square wave at all speeds; amplitude = max(curve(1 s peak susp velocity), low-speed floor(speed)); pooled from 5 Forza Motorsport laps (strength 0.5)
analysis.shift_indicator: on real laps: continuous ~66-70 Hz tone at full throttle, level ramps with rpm/max from ~0.78 (0.1) to 0.9+ (0.4) at strength 0.5; the synthetic probe never triggered it
analysis.gear_shift_lap: on laps HaptiConnect fires its ~94 ms burst on every gear-byte change (Forza passes through neutral -> two bursts ~220 ms), peak ~0.5-0.7 at strength 0.5, pitch randomized per trigger (p10 24, p50 51, p90 70 Hz)
